title: Noetherian irreducible cohomology vanishing
statement: Let X be an irreducible Noetherian topological space, let d be a nonnegative integer with dim X <= d [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], and let F be an abelian sheaf on X. Then H^q(X,F) [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology] is zero for every integer q>d.

proof.text: Strong induction on the natural dimension bound, with the assertion quantified over all Noetherian spaces, sheaves and degrees above that bound.

Use NoetherianSpace.exists_finset_irreducible on the whole closed space to obtain a finite irreducible closed cover; each member is Noetherian and irreducible and has dimension at most the ambient bound by topologicalKrullDim_subspace_le.
The private fixed-bound helper applies finite closed-cover vanishing to the irreducible vanishing hypothesis on each member.
On each irreducible member apply 02UX. NoetherianSpace.isCompact supplies the compact basis, compact intersections and CompactSpace instance.
Supply the integer extension-by-zero hypothesis using irreducible_integer_extension_vanishing with the strong induction hypothesis at every smaller bound.
Specialize the resulting all-spaces assertion to the given irreducible space, bound, sheaf and degree.
